description:
Create a 3D aerodynamic wing segment using provided airfoil coordinates. 

1. Import the airfoil coordinate file located at '~/Documents/FreeCAD/naca2412.dat'. This file defines a NACA 2412 profile with a 100mm chord.
2. Create a closed wire or sketch from these points.
3. Create a solid wing segment by extruding (padding) the profile 200 mm along the normal axis (Z-axis).
4. Ensure the final result is a valid Solid object.
5. Save the project as '~/Documents/FreeCAD/wing_section.FCStd'.
